title: End of session
summary: Confirm zero field, warm and unload the probe, and leave the cryostat in its approved standby state. Placeholder content written from general laboratory practice, not from the manufacturer's manual.

steps.title: Confirm zero field and warm safely
steps.body: Confirm that the field is at zero and that the magnet controller has completed its approved zero-field sequence. Disable sample excitation and warm the sample probe through the approved controls until it reaches the permitted handling temperature (SOP: __ K; warming rate: __ K/min). Complete the sample-space pressure-equalization sequence and wait for safe access status (SOP access pressure: __ [units: __]).
steps.check: Field is zero, excitation is off, the probe is safe to handle, and sample-space pressure permits opening.

steps.title: Open access and remove the probe
steps.body: Establish a slight He overpressure at the gas panel before opening the sample port (SOP: __ mbar gauge), and maintain it while the port is open. Remove the designated sample-access cover using the local loading procedure. Disconnect only the approved sample connections, then support and withdraw the probe slowly without forcing it. Cap the port immediately after withdrawing the probe, then place the probe in its designated holder.
steps.caution: Cold or snagged probes must not be pulled free; stop if there is frost, unexpected resistance, or uncertain temperature.

steps.title: Refit the cover for standby
steps.body: Confirm that the approved empty-port closure fitted immediately after withdrawal is secure and refit the designated cover, checking that no tools remain in the access area. Restore the required sample-space standby condition and leave the compressor and cooling services in the locally prescribed standby state.

steps.title: Document the final conditions
steps.body: Record the sample identifier, data location, completed field range, final temperature, and confirmed zero field. Note the probe storage location, standby service status, and any alarms or unexpected behavior.
